html:
Starting dialysis is a significant life adjustment that often brings up many questions and a bit of anxiety. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we believe that the more you know about the process, the more confident you will feel.

Our team in Ahmedabad is dedicated to making your treatment sessions as comfortable and safe as possible. We provide the expert renal care and emotional support necessary to help you navigate this journey while maintaining the highest quality of life.

What is Dialysis and Why is it Needed?

Dialysis performs the vital work your kidneys can no longer do, such as filtering waste, removing excess fluid, and balancing minerals in your blood. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we view dialysis as more than just a routine procedure; it is a specialized clinical support system.

Whether you are managing long-term kidney health or preparing for a surgical intervention, our facility provides the specialized care you would expect from a leading kidney transplant hospital in Ahmedabad.

What to Expect During Your Session?

We focus on a patient-first experience to ensure your comfort from the moment you walk in. Here is what your care journey with us looks like:

  • Initial Clinical Workup: Every patient undergoes a thorough medical check-up, including blood investigations and a 2D Echo, to monitor heart and kidney synchronization.
  • Safety & Monitoring: Our nursing staff and nephrologists monitor your vital signs throughout each session. For eligible patients, we offer these services at our Ranip branch under the PMJAY scheme, ensuring world-class care is accessible to all.
  • Vascular Access & Hygiene: We prioritize infection control and proper catheter or fistula care, which is essential for maintaining your health for future procedures.

Integrated Renal Care in Ahmedabad

Choosing the right healthcare partner is the most critical decision a renal patient can make. Our multispecialty approach ensures that your dialysis, urological health, and surgical planning are all managed under one roof. By combining advanced technology with compassionate expertise, we have established our reputation as a trusted kidney transplant hospital in Ahmedabad that prioritizes long-term patient outcomes.

Comprehensive Support Beyond Treatment at Silver Touch Hospitals

At Silver Touch Hospitals, we know that dialysis requires a lifestyle adjustment. Our team provides personalized nutritional counseling to help you manage fluid and salt intake, along with the psychological support needed to stay strong. We are here to ensure that your treatment fits into your life, rather than your life revolving around the treatment.

Are you or a loved one seeking expert renal care? Schedule a consultation with the specialists at Silver Touch Hospitals today to discuss your treatment plan.
